name: Fosazepam
summary: Fosazepam is a drug belonging to the benzodiazepine class, which are primarily anti-anxiety and sedative-hypnotic agents. It is a water soluble derivative of diazepam which has been substituted with a dimethylphosphoryl group to improve solubility in water.

pharmacology.text: The main metabolites of fosazepam are 3-hydroxyfosazepam and the active metabolite desmethyldiazepam which has a very long elimination half-life of about 3 days. Due to the very long elimination half-life of the active metabolite of fosazepam it is not recommended for use as a hypnotic.

uses.text: In a clinical trial it was reported that fosazepam to lead to increased sleep duration with less broken sleep but sleep quality was worsened with suppressed deep sleep and increased light sleep. Due to the very long elimination half-life of the active metabolite of fosazepam it is not recommended for use as a hypnotic.
